dateAssessment: Working campaign dates come from YAML and the dated Session 58 campaign record: the Morkalan confrontation is placed on August 25, 1748, and emergence on August 26. The transcript independently establishes elapsed hours and minutes, but no calendar date or civil watch; the earlier elapsed activities therefore retain open watches. The campaign record’s afternoon confrontation does not establish a unique watch for the preceding three-hour march. The prior Riswynn-session handoff likewise supplies no civil clock. The time extraction remains compatible with, rather than a verification of, the 82-day YAML span. The campaign record adds an escort and later travels through November 14, while YAML ends November 15; none of that later epilogue appears before the registered transcript ends at u3074.

watches.summary: Nora is reached after about an hour of the ongoing cliffside walk.
Rothfis completes his entire aerial scouting loop in about an hour.
Twenty–thirty minutes of walking, then another five, precede the troll ambush.
Rothfis recalls near-death about five minutes earlier, covering the post-combat cave approach and conversation.
An hour’s short rest in Del’s cave is completed before departure.
The march to the fort takes about three hours; its arrival watch is not uniquely established.
